text:
Maya (Finance): Heads-up — StrataBuy just sent an updated SKU mapping for our renewal and changed some unit defs. Can eng confirm which SKUs line up with our embedding vs inference usage? They want a reply by EOD Fri.

Raj (Procurement): Can you paste a few sample rows of our export? I need to run the tier math vs their new buckets.

Leo (Eng): I can look. Quick Q for Sam: what exactly is the difference between 'token-embedding' and 'embed-request' in the new map? Are we billed per-token for both or is embed-request per-call with a small token allowance?

Sam (StrataBuy Rep): Thanks — good question. New mapping: 'token-embedding' = per-1k tokens for embedding responses; 'embed-request' = per-call charge that covers the first 512 tokens of context/response, then per-token after. We can map your historical usage if you paste sample lines. We're open to a 10% list discount if you commit 12 months and keep spend >= $X/mo.

Maya (Finance): pasting a tiny sample from our export — please use for mapping: 

```
timestamp,sku,tokens,requests
2026-02-12T14:03:21Z,token-embedding,12400,1
2026-02-12T14:04:02Z,embed-request,32,3
2026-02-13T09:12:10Z,token-embedding,9800,1
2026-02-14T11:45:00Z,embed-request,512,1
```

Leo (Eng): Based on this sample ~80–85% of tokens map to token-embedding; embed-request is more request-county. If their per-call allowance is only 512 tokens we'll see overage for some long responses. Need a wider slice but can extrapolate.

Raj (Procurement): Sam — two asks: 1) can you provide pro-rated migration credits for SKU rename (we'll take the risk of mapping errors), and 2) can you cap overage pricing at 120% of committed rate for the first quarter post-renewal?

Sam (StrataBuy Rep): 1) We can offer one month of credits equal to your average spend in the last 30 days to account for the SKU change. 2) We can cap overages at 125% for Q1 instead of 120% — final if you sign within 5 business days. Also, we can propose a blended 'embed-all' SKU at a flat $0.0025 per token equivalent to simplify billing.

Maya (Finance): That cap is fine if we can get it in writing. Also need an attachable SKU mapping CSV that Legal can review. Can you export that and email legal@redwood.com?

Raj (Procurement): I'll run the tier math with the blended SKU option and post a delta vs current spend. Aiming to share pros/cons + number by Thu morning.

Leo (Eng): I'll produce a 30-day usage breakdown by SKU and tag you both.

Maya (Finance): Perfect — tagging @Raj and @Leo. If legal signs off by Fri we can lock the 12mo commit. :thumbsup:

InvoiceBot: Reminder: renewal quote must have procurement approval form submitted 72 hours before renewal date.

Sam (StrataBuy Rep): I'll email the CSV and a clean quote by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :pray:
